punchline: The skill he had written off as too hard was the one missing from his act.
thirty_sec: Steve Martin bombed as a young stand-up, copied other comedians, and still got no laughs. After a few years he realised he would have to write his own material, took a writing job, worked day and night, and later filled arenas.
question: Which task do you call "not my strength" while your results keep pointing straight at it?
key_contrast: Not more of what he did well, but the thing he avoided.
